svg.title: Where the factor of eight comes from
svg.desc: Geometry, the trace-reversed dust source, and Poisson’s equation combine to fix the coupling constant. The displayed component estimates assume weak, stationary fields and slow pressureless matter, with x⁰=ct. The matching is performed in the chapter with the full index conventions.

g.text: 19 / WHERE THE FACTOR OF EIGHT COMES FROM
Use the trace-reversed equation for slowly moving dust.

svg.data-tex: \text{The }4\pi\text{ comes from spherical flux. An extra }2\text{ compensates for the half-sized dust source.}
svg.aria-label: The 4π comes from spherical flux. The additional 2 compensates for the half-sized dust source.
